log.msg: read code/improvements.md (20 dated entries, 21 distinct traps counting the 2026-09-19 devbar-chat entry which names two) and code/SKILL.md section 7 (23 existing bullets). Drafted the consolidated additions.

write refused: Edit on .claude/skills/code/improvements.md (tried deleting the 2026-09-04 Router-hash entry as a real test, refused the same way). Falling back to skill-patch.md as the brief instructs — neither file will be touched this session.

regrouped against the brief's reading: split its single 'name that silently shadows or is ignored' family into two — the existing View-member-shadowing family stays as is, but icon-empty-box, index:true and the href object-literal trap became their own new family ('a config field can mean something narrower than it looks') because they are misread DATA fields, not shadowed METHODS, and a reader scanning for 'don't name a method X' would skim past them. Also added 7 standalone bullets the brief's five example families don't cover at all: export-pass-through, Router hash-on-click, View.html() sanitizer/SVG, the <details> toggle loop, a Server/ plugin's static "new"-event init order, flex-shrink:0 for card columns, and the DevBar shared-import blast-radius trap — each is a distinct failure shape with only one incident, so it got its own line rather than being forced into a family that doesn't fit.

refused to drop: kept the async-before-attach counter-lesson (the isConnected guard belongs on the LATER callback, never on the first draw) in full rather than trimming it to match the rAF/promise trap's length — cutting it is exactly the shape of mistake it exists to prevent, since a shortened version reads like a blanket 'always guard with isConnected' rule. Also kept the 2026-09-18 list-shapes entry that reinforces the return-value-appended-twice rule even though it adds no new fact (same bug, already on SKILL.md, just proves it still gets missed after being read) — folded its evidence (written 8 times in one file, the grep self-check) into the existing bullet instead of dropping it silently, since 'still bites after being read once' is itself worth an agent knowing.

write refused: Bash `node --check` on both traps-consolidate/page.js and the day page.js ("This command requires approval"), matching what safe-rollout/live-select/v3-ways-out hit earlier today. Both files hand-checked (balanced braces/quotes, matched the shape of a working sibling page.js) but not run through node.

write refused: reading the session's own usage jsonl under ~/.claude/projects/ (for the landing line's token sum) and running python for check-claude-usage were both refused/errored the same way as node and .claude/ writes — landing with tokens: null and window: null, same as safe-rollout/live-select/v3-ways-out did earlier today.

assign.outcome: **21 hard-won traps, folded from a backlog nobody reads into one section of the code skill — written, ready, not yet applied.** `code/improvements.md` held 20 dated entries (21 distinct traps) from 2026-09-04 to today, none ever folded into `code/SKILL.md`. Read all of them, grouped by actual failure shape (the ambient captor; comments/templates that close early; edit scripts that destroy files; async that resolves before a page attaches; config fields narrower than they look; seven traps that fit no family and stand alone), and wrote the consolidated section plus three new traps from today. 31 lines removed from `improvements.md`, about 20 added to `SKILL.md` — shorter, as required — and all 21 traps accounted for. This session's `Edit` calls to both `.claude/skills/code/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/code/improvements.md` were refused, so the exact replacement text for both files sits in [skill-patch.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-21/traps-consolidate/skill-patch.md), ready for the mastermind or the owner to paste in. `node --check` on this task's own two JS writes was also refused, so they're hand-checked, not run.
